_meta.description: Structured model of the Sahaja Yoga subtle system for the website/app. Public-facing fields come from official Sahaja Yoga USA chakra guides (us.sahajayoga.org/handouts) and shrimataji.org. Fields under 'practitioner' are traditional in-community knowledge that official public sites avoid; they need confirmation from the Sahaja Yoga collective before use.
_meta.hand_orientation_note: Fingers are the same on both hands. Left hand = left channel, right hand = right channel, both hands equally = centre channel.

kundalini.name: Kundalini
kundalini.location: Sacrum bone (triangular bone at the base of the spine), slightly above Mooladhara
kundalini.sanskrit_note: Ancient Greeks called the sacrum 'hieron osteon', sacred bone
kundalini.symbol: Spiral coiled 3.5 times inside a triangle
kundalini.felt_as: Cool breeze on the palms and above the fontanel; may feel warm at first

chakras.name: Mooladhara
chakras.title: Innocence and Wisdom
chakras.location: Pelvic plexus, base of the spine
chakras.hand_point: Base of the palm / wrist (both hands)
balance_with: Sit on the earth, palms down beside hips

chakras.name: Swadisthan
chakras.title: Creativity
physical: Supplies energy to the brain's grey cells
balance_with: Right side: cold or iced salt water, ice pack above right hip-crease
Left side: hot salt water, candle flame in front of left Swadisthan

chakras.name: Nabhi
chakras.title: Generosity, Evolution, Contentment
chakras.location: Spinal column at the level of the navel; solar plexus
balance_with: Right hand rotating clockwise in front of Nabhi

chakras.name: Void (Bhavasagara)
chakras.title: Ocean of Illusion / Self-mastery
chakras.hand_point: Ring around the centre of the palm

practitioner.deity: Adi Guru (Dattatreya) and the ten primordial masters

chakras.name: Anahat (Heart)
chakras.title: Love, Compassion, Security
chakras.location: Spinal column behind the sternum; cardiac plexus
balance_with: Right hand rotating clockwise in front of the heart
Right hand on heart: 'I am one with my spirit.'

practitioner.deity: Centre: Shri Jagadamba; Left: Shiva-Parvati; Right: Sita-Rama

chakras.name: Vishuddhi
chakras.title: Communication, Diplomacy, Collectivity
balance_with: Right hand rotating clockwise in front of the throat
Candle flame at left neck-shoulder junction
Speak from the heart, praise rather than criticise

chakras.name: Agnya
chakras.title: Forgiveness
chakras.location: Optic chiasma, centre of the forehead
balance_with: Meditate outdoors looking at the sky
Right hand on forehead: 'I forgive everyone, including myself.'

practitioner.deity: Lord Jesus Christ and Mother Mary

chakras.name: Sahasrara
chakras.title: Integration
chakras.location: Limbic area of the brain; exits at the fontanel
balance_with: Right palm on the crown, rotate clockwise: 'Let me experience the state of meditation.'

practitioner.deity: Shri Adi Shakti / Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi (Shri Kalki on the right)

self_realization_sequence.source: Positions and order verified from shrimataji.org/experience-your-self-realization (nine illustrations). Affirmation wording and repetition counts are the traditional guided wording; confirm with the Sahaja Yoga collective before shipping.
self_realization_sequence.setup: Sit comfortably, shoes off, left palm open upward on lap toward Shri Mataji's photo, right hand works on the left side of the body, eyes closed.

steps.position: Right hand on the upper left abdomen
steps.affirmation: Mother, am I my own master?

steps.position: Right hand on the lower left abdomen
steps.affirmation: Mother, please give me pure knowledge.

steps.position: Right hand on the upper left abdomen
steps.affirmation: Mother, I am my own master.
Mother, I am not this body, I am not this mind, I am the pure Spirit.

steps.position: Right hand at the junction of the neck and left shoulder, head turned right
steps.affirmation: Mother, I am not guilty at all.

steps.position: Right hand across the forehead, head bowed
Right hand on the back of the head, head tilted back
steps.affirmation: O Divine Power, if I have made any mistakes, please forgive me.

steps.position: Right palm on the fontanel, fingers back, press and rotate clockwise
steps.affirmation: Mother, please give me my self-realization.

self_realization_sequence.after: Check for a cool or warm breeze: left palm above the head, then right. If nothing is felt, say 'I forgive everyone' a few more times.

steps.position: Lower left side, just above the hip
steps.affirmation: Mother Kundalini, I want to experience the pure knowledge.

steps.position: Up the left side, just below the ribcage

steps.affirmation: I am one with my spirit.

steps.position: Left shoulder where it meets the neck
Across the forehead, head slightly lowered

steps.affirmation: Let me experience the state of meditation.

first_week_sequence_official.then: Hand about six inches above the head, palm down, move up and down to feel warmth or coolness. Sit 5 to 10 minutes in silence.

techniques.raising_kundalini: Left hand in front of the lower abdomen, palm facing body, rises up the front of the body while the right hand circles it clockwise. Above the head, tie a knot. Repeat three times: one knot, then two, then three.
techniques.bandhan: Shield of protection. Left palm up on lap. Right hand travels from the left hip up over the head and down to the right hip, then back, palm facing the body about two inches away. One left-right-left arc = one; do 7.
techniques.foot_soak: Evening. Lukewarm water to the ankles with a handful of salt, candle in front, palms up, eyes open. Ask Mother Kundalini to absorb imbalances into the salt water. Up to 10 minutes, rinse, flush, then meditate.
techniques.ice_pack: On the liver (right side) to cool the right channel.
techniques.candle: Flame for the left channel (e.g. left Swadisthan, left Vishuddhi).
techniques.clockwise_rotation: Right hand rotating clockwise a few inches from a chakra, the natural spin of a balanced chakra.
